title: neuroloma pulvinatum
intro: Neuroloma pulvinatum, commonly known as "wild chamomile", is a flowering plant in the Asteraceae family, native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been used for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Neuroloma pulvinatum include treating anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues, while its bioactive constituents include apigenin, a flavonoid with antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The plant's bioactive constituents may also contribute to its reported ability to reduce stress and promote relaxation.
